summary: Adds a maxUnit option to pretty-bytes so output can be capped at a chosen unit (2e12 with maxUnit 'GB' gives '2000 GB'). It throws a TypeError for units outside the selected system. Includes readme, types and tests.
narrative: The owner opened one conversation on 2026-11-03 asking for a maxUnit option in pretty-bytes. It should follow the unit names of the bits/binary system in use and throw a TypeError for an unknown unit, with readme, types and tests. Memory holds no observations for this conversation yet, and no PR, release or owner confirmation. It is recorded as just started, with no implementation evidence.
